answer: WITH s AS (SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2 AS stress_score FROM system_controller sc JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref), m AS (SELECT *, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY model) AS avg_model_stress FROM s) SELECT robot_id, LOWER(model) AS model, stress_score, avg_model_stress FROM m WHERE stress_score > 1.2 * avg_model_stress ORDER BY stress_score DESC, robot_id

SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, mf.faultpredscore AS fault_prediction_score, mf.rulhours / 24.0 AS rul_days FROM maintenance_and_fault mf JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = mf.upkeepactuation WHERE mf.rulhours / 24.0 < 7 AND mf.faultpredscore > 0.7 ORDER BY rul_days ASC, mf.faultpredscore DESC
SELECT ROUND(AVG((j.value->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric), 2) AS avg_joint_vibration FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) AS j

WITH b AS (SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, a.payloadwval / rd.payloadcapkg AS payload_utilization_ratio, 60.0 / o.cycletimesecval AS throughput_rate, o.apptypeval FROM operation o JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = o.operreg JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref WHERE o.cycletimesecval IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT *, NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY apptypeval ORDER BY throughput_rate DESC) AS quintile FROM b) SELECT robot_id, model, payload_utilization_ratio, throughput_rate FROM q WHERE quintile = 1 AND payload_utilization_ratio > 0.8 ORDER BY payload_utilization_ratio DESC, throughput_rate DESC
note: Included robot_id as leading column since the question lists robots; NTILE computed per application type over robots with a cycle time.

answer: WITH t AS (SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS op, (SELECT AVG((v->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k, v)) AS avg_temp, (SELECT MAX((v->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k, v)) AS max_temp, (SELECT MIN((v->>'temperature_C')::numeric) FROM jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k, v)) AS min_temp FROM joint_condition jc), p AS (SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, mf.upkeepoperation AS op, (1000.0 / (mf.rulhours + 1)) + mf.faultpredscore * 10 AS pmu FROM maintenance_and_fault mf JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = mf.upkeepactuation) SELECT p.robot_id, rd.modelseriesval AS model, p.pmu AS maintenance_urgency_score, t.max_temp AS max_joint_temperature FROM p JOIN t ON t.op = p.op JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = p.robot_id WHERE p.pmu > 50 AND (t.avg_temp > 75 OR t.max_temp - t.min_temp > 15) ORDER BY p.pmu DESC, t.max_temp DESC

SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, o.apptypeval AS application_type, a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval AS relative_positional_error, ps.calibstateval AS calibration_state FROM operation o JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actoperref = o.operreg JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON ps.effectivenessactuation = a.actreg WHERE o.apptypeval IN ('Assembly', 'Electronics-Handling', 'Inspection', 'Dispensing', 'Laser Cutting') AND a.poserrmmval / rd.reachmmval > 0.0001 ORDER BY relative_positional_error DESC
note: Inner join to performance_and_safety drops 19 qualifying robots that have no calibration record.

answer: SELECT LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) AS manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS degrading_robot_count, AVG((1.0 - ps.conditionindexval) / (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval)) AS avg_health_degradation_rate FROM performance_and_safety ps JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot WHERE (1.0 - ps.conditionindexval) / (CURRENT_DATE - rd.instdateval) > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(rd.mfgnameval) HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
note: Counts performance records (a few robots have two); COUNT(DISTINCT robot) would be slightly lower.

answer: WITH s AS (SELECT a.actrecref AS robot_id, sc.systemoverseeroperation AS op, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model, (sc.overseerloadvalue + sc.memuseval) / 2 AS stress_score FROM system_controller sc JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = sc.systemoverseeractuation JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = a.actrecref), m AS (SELECT *, AVG(stress_score) OVER (PARTITION BY model) AS avg_model_stress FROM s), w AS (SELECT jc.jcondoperref AS op, 0.6 * AVG((v->>'vibration_mmps')::numeric) + 0.4 * AVG((v->>'backlash_deg')::numeric) AS mws FROM joint_condition jc CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(jc.joint_health) e(k, v) GROUP BY jc.jcondid, jc.jcondoperref) SELECT m.robot_id, m.manufacturer, LOWER(m.model) AS model, m.stress_score, w.mws AS mechanical_wear_score FROM m JOIN w ON w.op = m.op WHERE m.stress_score >= 1.2 * m.avg_model_stress AND w.mws >= 0.5 ORDER BY m.manufacturer, m.stress_score DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN o.apptypeval IN ('Welding', 'Grinding', 'Deburring', 'Palletizing', 'Machine Tending') THEN 'High-Wear Applications' ELSE 'Other Applications' END AS application_group, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.totopshrval / NULLIF(ps.emergencystopcount, 0) < 500) / COUNT(*), 2) AS high_risk_percentage FROM performance_and_safety ps JOIN actuation_data a ON a.actreg = ps.effectivenessactuation JOIN operation o ON o.operreg = a.actoperref GROUP BY 1
note: Denominator is all robots with a safety record in the group; zero emergency stops treated as not at risk.

answer: SELECT o.operrecref AS robot_id, rd.mfgnameval AS manufacturer, rd.modelseriesval AS model, ROUND((3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval)::numeric, 2) AS throughput_cph FROM operation o JOIN robot_details rd ON rd.botdetreg = o.operrecref WHERE 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval < 180 ORDER BY 3600.0 / o.cycletimesecval ASC LIMIT 5
